title: Smoother continuous swiping
summary: The bottom selector now follows one continuous drag across all tabs, while screen swipes lock reliably and work from Chat too.
changes: Drag once across the bottom bar and the selector follows your finger continuously through Night, Changes, Breaks and Chat, then settles on the nearest tab.
Screen swipes lock onto a horizontal gesture once established, so small diagonal movement no longer cancels the page halfway through.
Safe noninteractive areas of Chat can now swipe back toward Breaks, while message areas, composers, forms, workflow controls, dialogs and edge gestures remain protected.
The bottom bar uses a more stable opaque glass layer so underlying cards do not look like a second broken bar. Roster calculations, Supabase data and authentication are unchanged.
